preservation.primaryReadingSet: One standalone theory manuscript, twelve assembled portfolio articles, five separately labeled native validation reports and six retained native technical studies; current technical documents also have a dedicated reading room.
preservation.authoringSources: 12 page bodies, five topic fragments, and shared head/footer remain accessible as authoring sources, with links to their assembled article.
preservation.mechanics: Preserve relative directory structure, inline styles/scripts/SVG/data-image URLs; copy each existing local dependency transitively; rewrite source-code/Markdown links to packaged source-note routes. Keep originals unchanged.
preservation.warning: Original prose is preserved as a dated source document. Several pages contain their own retractions and unfinished-feature ledgers. Current source code and attached measurement producers take precedence over historical prose; raw authoring fragments may carry claims qualified later in assembled sections.
preservation.externalAssets: Historical manuscripts reference Google Fonts, with system-font fallbacks. Generated validation assets are local; the native report shell has local-preview navigation links to 127.0.0.1:4185. The integrated public validation route uses relative portfolio navigation. No remote JavaScript, CDN math engine or external image is required by these reports.
preservation.links: The packaged reading tree resolves sibling HTML and local fragments. The mesh-sheet source points to a native docs-root index that is absent; the same relative link resolves to the generated library index in its reading copy. Original HTML bytes remain unchanged.
preservation.sources: Do not rerun assemble.py merely to publish: current assembled HTML already embeds its evidence, whereas rebuilding requires untracked PGR1 film dumps, configuration sidecars and hash checks.
